policy: Human SME review contract for technical assessment outcome mapping. Only mappings with reviewStatus='approved', current reviewedItemRevision, approved referenced outcomes, independenceReviewed=true, an independenceRationale, reviewedBy and reviewedAt are counted. Pending/proposed mappings never count toward breadth. This repository is public; reviewers should use only attribution they intend to publish.
